releases.name: v1.0.0
releases.notes:
## What this is

`skill_management` adds a switchboard for the skills installed in your OpenCode setup: see what is installed, find out why one will not load, take one out of the model's view, and put it back.

Disabling never touches skill files. It writes **one** `skill` permission rule into your global config (`effect: "deny"`, or `"ask"` for a soft disable). Nothing is deleted, moved or rewritten, and removing that rule restores the skill exactly as it was.

This is the first stable release: the surface described below is frozen for 1.x.

## What it does

| Action | What it does | Writes config |
|---|---|---|
| `list` | Every registered skill with its effective state for the calling agent (`available` / `disabled` / `ask`) | no |
| `inspect` | Why one skill is (un)available: the matching rule, per-agent differences, how its id was derived | no |
| `disable` | Hide it from the model and reject loading it (`effect: "ask"` keeps it listed and asks on load) | yes |
| `enable` | Remove the blocking rule again, whoever wrote it | yes |

How a permission is resolved: the host reads the rule set of **the agent that is calling**, takes the last match (`findLast`) with `*` / `?` globs, and — when nothing matches — falls back to `ask`, not `allow`. That is why `list` and `inspect` evaluate per agent and name the agent they used.

en.headline: 49 commits across four repositories and one v1.0.0 release
en.summary: **49 commits** were recorded across four repositories, with 32 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, 32 own commits updated review validation, provider lookup, CSS toast scoping, translation review flags, and documentation for MT/LLM comparisons. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 10 own commits added CLI help, decoupled provider chains into `config/providers.json`, adjusted fallback lanes, and changed the active chain to deepseek → sensenova. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 6 own commits added an Astro + Starlight documentation site, CI deployment, release policy, and the `v1.0.0` release. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 1 own commit documented planning capabilities. The `v1.0.0` release of `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` introduced skill listing, inspection, and reversible disabling through a global `skill` permission rule. Separately, issue #5489 in `openchamber/openchamber` received a reply from `openchamber-bot[bot]` and was closed by yulia-ivashko.

releaseNotes.summary: This first stable release added a switchboard for OpenCode skills, including `list` and `inspect` actions. Disabling a skill writes a single `skill` permission rule with `effect: "deny"` or `"ask"` without deleting or rewriting skill files, and removing the rule restores the skill.

zh.headline: 四个仓库共 49 次提交，并发布 v1.0.0
zh.summary: 当天共记录 **49 次提交**，另有 32 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 的 32 次本人提交更新了审查校验、provider 查找、CSS toast 作用域、翻译审查标记及 MT/LLM 对比文档。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 10 次本人提交加入 CLI 帮助，将 provider 链解耦到 `config/providers.json`，调整兜底目录，并把链路改为 deepseek → sensenova。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 6 次本人提交新增 Astro + Starlight 文档站、CI 部署、发布政策及 `v1.0.0` 发布。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 1 次本人提交记录了规划类能力。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 发布 `v1.0.0`，提供技能列表、检查及通过全局 `skill` 权限规则进行可逆停用的功能。此外，`openchamber/openchamber` 的 issue #5489 收到 `openchamber-bot[bot]` 的回复，并由 yulia-ivashko 关闭。

releaseNotes.summary: 首个稳定版本提供 OpenCode 技能管理入口，包含 `list` 和 `inspect` 操作。停用技能时仅写入一条 `effect: "deny"` 或 `"ask"` 的 `skill` 权限规则，不删除或重写技能文件，移除该规则即可恢复技能。
